author: root

senses.definition: a substance with a sour taste that can react with other materials; some kinds can burn skin
senses.example: Lemon juice contains a weak acid.

senses.definition: having a sour taste or acidic properties, or showing sharp unkind humour
senses.example: She replied with an acid comment.

reviewNotes: 酸的名词、形容词均保留；柠檬汁与尖刻评论分别展示两种用法。

author: root

senses.zh: 可能性；胜算；赔率；分歧（at odds）
senses.definition: the chance of an event or the terms of a bet; in at odds, a disagreement
senses.example: The odds of finding my ring in the park are low.

reviewNotes: odds 主要作复数名词；把 at odds 的分歧义标明为固定搭配，避免误学成独立名词。

author: root

senses.zh: 媒介；手段；创作材料；培养基；灵媒
senses.definition: a way to communicate, a material used in art or science, or a person claiming contact with the dead
senses.example: Film is a powerful medium for telling stories.

senses.definition: in the middle of a range of sizes or amounts; for meat, cooked but still slightly pink inside
senses.example: I usually wear a medium shirt.

reviewNotes: 媒介、材料与中等尺寸均成立；替换了不能直接作单数 medium 搭配的 social media。

author: root

senses.zh: 身体上；体力上；物理上；亲自
senses.definition: in a way involving the body, physical effort, or the material world
senses.example: The job is physically demanding, so he rests well at night.

reviewNotes: 身体和物理层面均核对；把 physically present 对应的中文改为亲自在场。

author: root

senses.definition: the land along the edge of the sea, a lake, or a wide river
senses.example: We walked along the shore and collected shells.

senses.zh: 支撑；支持巩固（常用 shore up）
senses.definition: to support a structure or make a weak system, position, or plan stronger
senses.example: They added posts to shore up the roof.

reviewNotes: 海岸名词优先，shore up 动词保留；删掉不适合基础词卡的专业支撑柱义。

author: root

senses.definition: many times, often in the same way
senses.example: I called repeatedly, but nobody answered.

reviewNotes: 反复多次的副词义与电话例句一致。

author: root

senses.zh: 区分；辨认；使有别；使出众
senses.definition: to tell things apart, notice something clearly, or make someone or something different or outstanding
senses.example: Can you distinguish these two bird calls?

reviewNotes: 区分两种鸟叫和 distinguish between/from 的搭配一致。

author: root

senses.definition: one of the two organs in the chest that take in air when a person or animal breathes
senses.example: Air enters the lungs when you breathe in.

reviewNotes: 肺是核心义；去掉抽象城市绿肺比喻，以免掩盖身体器官义。

author: root

senses.zh: 艺术的；有艺术才能的；有美感的
senses.definition: connected with art, skilled in creating art, or made in an attractive and creative way
senses.example: Her artistic skills helped her design the poster.

reviewNotes: 艺术相关与有艺术才能的义项均对应海报设计例句。

author: root

senses.definition: serious speech or writing about a subject, or the way people discuss it
senses.example: The issue became part of public discourse.

senses.definition: to speak or write at length about a subject
senses.example: The speaker discoursed on the history of the town.

reviewNotes: 公共话语的名词和正式论述的动词都核对，动词例句明确正式语境。

author: root

senses.zh: 不同的；分明的；明确的；显著的
senses.definition: clearly different, easy to notice, or certain and definite
senses.example: The two rooms have distinct purposes.

reviewNotes: 不同与明显两类形容词义均可从房间用途、气味搭配理解。

author: root

senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；给人深刻印象的
senses.definition: making people admire something because of its quality, size, skill, or success
senses.example: She made impressive progress in a few weeks.

reviewNotes: 令人赞叹的义项与进步、成就等搭配对应。

author: root

senses.definition: a person or organisation trying to win the same contest or customers as others
senses.example: Each competitor had three attempts.

reviewNotes: 竞争者可指参赛者和商界对手，竞赛例句体现主用法。

author: root

senses.definition: a dry substance made of very small pieces, including powder used on the face
senses.example: Add a little cocoa powder to the milk.

senses.definition: to put fine dry material on a surface or crush something into very small pieces
senses.example: She powdered her face before the performance.

reviewNotes: 粉末和扑粉两词性成立；不把火药等较专门义挤进主释义。

author: root

senses.zh: 丑的；难看的；令人不快的；险恶的
senses.definition: unpleasant to look at, upsetting, or likely to become violent or harmful
senses.example: The argument turned ugly when they began shouting.

reviewNotes: 丑陋和事态变糟均属常用形容词用法；例句体现后者。

author: root

senses.zh: 描绘；描写；扮演；把……描述成
senses.definition: to show someone or something in art or words, or play a character in a film or show
senses.example: The film portrays life in a small village.

reviewNotes: 电影描绘生活和扮演角色均属 portray 的常见用法。

author: root

senses.zh: 适度的；中等的；温和的；不极端的
senses.definition: not very large, strong, or extreme; staying between opposite positions
senses.example: The walk requires a moderate level of fitness.

senses.zh: 使缓和；减轻；主持；审核内容
senses.definition: to make less extreme, lead a discussion, or check that shared content follows rules
senses.example: She will moderate the discussion after the talk.

senses.zh: 温和派；持中间立场的人
senses.definition: a person whose political or other views are not extreme
senses.example: Moderates in the party supported the agreement.

reviewNotes: 适度的形容词、主持讨论的动词、温和派名词均保留，例句与各义相符。

author: root

senses.definition: to make someone agree to do or believe something by giving reasons or encouragement
senses.example: I persuaded him to take a short break.

reviewNotes: 说服某人做事及 persuade someone of/that 的结构核对。

author: root

senses.definition: the spirit of a dead person as imagined by some people, or a faint sign of something
senses.example: There was a ghost of a smile on her face.

senses.zh: 突然断联；不再回复（非正式）
senses.definition: to suddenly stop replying to someone's calls or messages without explaining why
senses.example: After two friendly meetings, he suddenly ghosted me.

reviewNotes: 鬼魂及突然断联均是现用义；动词去掉少见的代笔义。

author: root

senses.definition: happening or coming after something else
senses.example: The first visit was free, but subsequent visits cost money.

reviewNotes: 随后的形容词义及 subsequent to 搭配核对。

author: root

senses.zh: 运输公司；携带者；运载工具；航母；运营商
senses.definition: a company, person, vehicle, or object that carries things; a ship for aircraft; a phone network provider
senses.example: Check the baggage rules with your carrier.

reviewNotes: 运输商、携带者、航母、运营商共用承载核心；行李规则例句具体。

author: root

senses.definition: happening many times or at short intervals
senses.example: We make frequent trips to the library.

senses.definition: to visit or spend time in a place often
senses.example: Local artists frequent this small cafe.

evidence.note: 本轮搜索返回官方词条内容，核对现代常用义与词性；释义例句自主编写。

reviewNotes: 频繁形容词为主，常去某地的正式动词保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
senses.example: The school banned smoking on its grounds.

senses.definition: an official rule that does not allow an activity or item
senses.example: There is a ban on parking in this street.

reviewNotes: 禁止的动词与禁令名词均保留，学校禁烟例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: very bad or unpleasant, or very great in amount or degree in informal speech
senses.example: I had an awful headache yesterday.

reviewNotes: 糟糕的形容词为主；删掉不宜当标准用法教的地区性口语副词。

仅在部分口语或地区性表达中作程度副词；成人主卡优先通用标准形容词义。

author: root

senses.definition: to respect someone for their qualities or look at something with pleasure
senses.example: I admire her patience with the children.

reviewNotes: 钦佩人和欣赏景色两个对象的用法都成立。

author: root

senses.definition: an animal kept for company, or a person treated as a favourite
senses.example: Our cat has always been a much-loved pet.

senses.zh: 特别喜爱的；特别关注的；养作宠物的
senses.definition: especially liked or personally important, or kept for company rather than work
senses.example: This is one of his pet projects.

senses.definition: to gently touch an animal or person, or treat someone with special affection
senses.example: The child asked if she could pet the dog.

reviewNotes: 宠物、特别喜爱的形容词及抚摸的动词均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 奇迹；非凡的成就；不可思议的事
senses.definition: an event believed to have a divine cause, or something so surprising and good that it seems almost impossible
senses.example: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt.

reviewNotes: 奇迹既可宗教也可泛指出乎意料的好结果；例句体现后者。

author: root

senses.zh: 节奏；韵律；规律性的变化
senses.definition: a repeated pattern of beats, sounds, movements, or changes
senses.example: We clapped to the rhythm of the music.

notes: 节奏/韵律与旋律 melody 有区别，不把 rhythm 首义译为旋律。

evidence.note: 本轮搜索返回官方词条内容，核对现代常用义与词性；释义例句自主编写。

reviewNotes: 节奏可指音乐或日常规律，拍手例句清楚。

author: root

senses.definition: to be greater than a number, limit, or expected standard
senses.example: The final cost exceeded our budget.

reviewNotes: 超过预算、期望与限速的搭配均自然。

author: root

senses.zh: 广泛的；普遍的；分布广的
senses.definition: found or happening in many places or among many people
senses.example: The plan received widespread support.

reviewNotes: 广泛分布和普遍支持的义项及例句一致。

author: root

senses.definition: an act against religious or moral rules, or something considered very wrong
senses.example: He believed that lying was a sin.

senses.definition: to do something against religious or moral rules
senses.example: The story is about a man who sins and later seeks forgiveness.

reviewNotes: 宗教或道德罪过的名词、犯罪的动词均保留，未混为法律犯罪。

author: root

senses.definition: a unit for measuring land, equal to about 4,047 square metres
senses.example: The farm covers twenty acres.

reviewNotes: 英亩单位与土地面积例句对应。

author: root

senses.zh: 剧本；讲稿；文字体系；笔迹；脚本程序
senses.definition: words prepared for a performance or speech, a writing system or style, or a short computer program
senses.example: The actors read the script together.

senses.zh: 写剧本；编写讲稿或脚本
senses.definition: to write the words or instructions for a performance, speech, or computer task
senses.example: She scripted a short film about her childhood.

reviewNotes: 剧本、文字、计算机脚本及编写剧本的动词均有语境。

author: root

senses.zh: 慈善机构；慈善；宽容；仁爱
senses.definition: an organisation or activity that helps people in need, or kindness when judging others
senses.example: The event raised money for a local charity.

reviewNotes: 慈善机构、慈善行为和宽容义均可用，募款例句优先常用义。

author: root

senses.definition: a particular action used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage
senses.example: Changing the subject was a delaying tactic.

reviewNotes: 策略的一项具体行动义和 delaying tactic 搭配准确。

author: root

senses.definition: the ocean between the Americas and Europe and Africa
senses.example: They flew across the Atlantic overnight.

senses.zh: 大西洋的；大西洋沿岸的
senses.definition: connected with that ocean or the lands beside it
senses.example: The town lies on the Atlantic coast.

reviewNotes: 大西洋专名与大西洋沿岸的形容词分别保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 识别；身份确认；身份证明；认同
senses.definition: recognising who or what something is, proof of identity, or a feeling of connection with someone
senses.example: You need identification to collect the parcel.

reviewNotes: 身份确认、身份证明及认同义可区分，取包裹例句落实主用法。

author: root

senses.definition: a major change in appearance, form, character, or the way something works
senses.example: The old factory's transformation into a library took two years.

reviewNotes: 显著转变的名词义与工厂改造例句一致。

author: root

senses.zh: 日常的；普通的；每天使用的
senses.definition: ordinary or used as part of normal daily life
senses.example: The course teaches English for everyday situations.
senses.note: everyday 是形容词，如 everyday life；表示每天做某事用两个词 every day。

reviewNotes: everyday 是形容词日常的，不与 every day 时间短语混淆。

author: root

senses.zh: 火鸡；火鸡肉；失败之作（非正式）
senses.definition: a large bird raised for food, its meat, or a very unsuccessful film or other product
senses.example: We had roast turkey for dinner.
senses.note: 小写 turkey 是火鸡；国家名应大写 Turkey（现常用 Türkiye），不把国家义混入本卡。

reviewNotes: 火鸡和火鸡肉均常见；失败作品的非正式义放在后部。

author: root

senses.zh: 新闻标题；头条；重要新闻摘要
senses.definition: the title of a news report, or the main news stories
senses.example: The headline caught my attention.

senses.zh: 给……加标题；担任主角或主打演出
senses.definition: to give a news story a title or be the main performer at an event
senses.example: The band will headline the festival on Saturday.

reviewNotes: 新闻标题名词和担任主打演出的动词均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 风险项目；新企业；冒险活动
senses.definition: a new activity or business that involves risk or an uncertain result
senses.example: Opening the cafe was their first business venture.

senses.zh: 冒险去；大胆提出；冒险投入
senses.definition: to go somewhere despite risk, say something despite uncertainty, or risk money or another valuable thing
senses.example: She ventured outside after the storm.

reviewNotes: 风险性新事业名词及冒险尝试动词均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 入侵；侵略；侵犯；大量涌入
senses.definition: entering a place by force or in large numbers, or unfairly entering someone's private life
senses.example: The new cameras felt like an invasion of privacy.

reviewNotes: 军事入侵、隐私侵犯和大量涌入均与 invasion 相符。

author: root

senses.definition: enough or good enough for a particular need, without being especially good
senses.example: The room has adequate space for a small desk.

reviewNotes: adequate 只表示够用，并非优秀；例句保持这层语气。

author: root

senses.definition: despite what has just been said
senses.example: The work was difficult. Nonetheless, we finished on time.

学习者词典主要标为副词；旧版连词标注与句中实际用法不符。

reviewNotes: nonetheless 应作转折副词而非连接词；移除旧卡的连词标注。

author: root

senses.zh: 强度；强烈程度；专注程度
senses.definition: how strong, powerful, or concentrated something is
senses.example: The intensity of the light made it hard to see.

reviewNotes: 强度义可用于光、运动及情绪，例句落在光强。

author: root

senses.zh: 食品杂货店；食品杂货（常用复数）
senses.definition: a shop selling food and household items, or those items when the word is used in the plural
senses.example: I need to buy groceries on the way home.

reviewNotes: grocery 单数店铺与复数 groceries 购物杂货要区分；例句显式用复数。

author: root

senses.definition: to show objects publicly or display a quality or sign
senses.example: Local artists will exhibit their work next month.

senses.definition: an object shown to the public, an item used as evidence, or a public display
senses.example: The museum's newest exhibit is a model ship.

reviewNotes: 展出动词、展品及证物名词均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: a small animal with a long tail, or a device for controlling a computer pointer
senses.example: Move the mouse to select the picture.

reviewNotes: 老鼠与电脑鼠标两核心义优先，去掉较次要的人格比喻。

author: root

senses.definition: a warm cover for a bed, or a layer that covers a wide area
senses.example: Snow formed a white blanket over the fields.

senses.definition: to cover something completely or over a wide area
senses.example: Thick fog blanketed the town.

senses.definition: applying to every person or situation without making distinctions
senses.example: The council rejected a blanket ban on outdoor music.

reviewNotes: 毯子、覆盖及全面适用的形容词义均成立。

author: root

senses.zh: 页边空白；边缘；差额；利润率；余地
senses.definition: an empty edge, the difference between two amounts, the share of sales kept as profit, or room for error
senses.example: Leave a wide margin on the left side of the page.

reviewNotes: 页边、差距、利润率及容错余地共用边界或差额概念。

author: root

senses.definition: a thick strong cord made by twisting strands together
senses.example: Tie the boat to the post with a rope.

senses.definition: to fasten or catch with a cord, or persuade someone to join an activity
senses.example: They roped off the damaged section of the path.

reviewNotes: 绳索名词与圈起、拉人入伙的动词搭配核对。

author: root

senses.definition: a hard building material made by mixing cement with sand, small stones, and water
senses.example: The path is made of concrete.

senses.zh: 具体的；确实的；混凝土制的
senses.definition: clear and specific rather than abstract, based on facts, or made from a hard building mixture
senses.example: We need concrete evidence before making a decision.

senses.definition: to cover a surface with a hard building mixture that sets solid
senses.example: They concreted the small yard behind the house.
senses.note: 作动词较少见，日常学习先掌握名词混凝土和形容词具体的。

reviewNotes: 混凝土名词、具体的形容词及铺混凝土的少见动词均保留并标明动词较少见。

author: root

senses.zh: 处方；处方药；建议方案；规定
senses.definition: a medical order for a medicine, the medicine ordered, or a suggested way to deal with a problem
senses.example: She took the prescription to the pharmacy.

reviewNotes: 处方、处方药和解决方案比喻均可用；药房例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: to run after someone or something, try to achieve a goal, or ask repeatedly for money or a reply
senses.example: The dog chased a ball across the garden.

senses.definition: the act of trying to catch someone or obtain something
senses.example: The film opened with a car chase.

reviewNotes: 追赶和追求保留；去掉低频金属雕刻义，避免主卡冗杂。

author: root

senses.definition: to find and bring new people into a job, team, army, or other group
senses.example: The company is recruiting more engineers.

senses.definition: a person who has recently joined an organisation or the armed forces
senses.example: Each new recruit receives a week of training.

reviewNotes: 招聘动词与新成员名词分别用公司、培训例句。

author: root

senses.definition: a hard block used to build walls, or an object of a similar shape
senses.example: The house is built of red brick.

senses.zh: 用砖砌；封堵；使电子设备失效（非正式）
senses.definition: to build or block with hard building blocks, or make an electronic device unable to work
senses.example: A failed update can brick the device.

reviewNotes: 砖与使设备失效的动词保留；去掉过时的人格赞语。

author: root

senses.zh: 补丁；一小块；斑块；时期；软件补丁
senses.definition: a piece used to cover a hole, a small area or mark, a period, or a small software update
senses.example: There is a patch of sunlight on the floor.

senses.definition: to repair with a small piece or update, or connect a call or signal
senses.example: The team patched the software before the launch.

reviewNotes: 补丁与修补动词均成立；软件更新例句贴近日常。

author: root

senses.definition: an opinion or decision generally agreed on by a group
senses.example: The team reached a consensus on the new design.

reviewNotes: consensus 是集体达成的共识，reach a consensus 搭配自然。

author: root

senses.zh: 恐惧；震惊；可怕的事物；恐怖作品
senses.definition: a strong feeling of fear or shock, something terrible, or stories designed to frighten people
senses.example: She watched in horror as the bridge collapsed.

reviewNotes: 恐惧、恐怖作品、可怕事件的名词用法均核对。

author: root

senses.zh: 殖民的；殖民地的；殖民时期的
senses.definition: connected with a place controlled by another country or with that period of its history
senses.example: The museum explores the country's colonial past.

senses.zh: 殖民者；殖民地的外来定居者
senses.definition: a person from another country who lives in a colony, especially within its ruling system
senses.example: Some colonials returned to their home country after independence.

reviewNotes: 殖民的形容词为主；名词指殖民者，去掉地区性建筑物简称。

author: root

senses.definition: someone who creates pictures using paint or whose job is to paint buildings
senses.example: The painter is putting a second coat on the door.

reviewNotes: 画家和油漆工是两项常见义；去掉航海系缆的冷僻义。

author: root

senses.zh: 馅饼；可分配的总额（比喻）
senses.definition: food baked inside or under pastry, or a total amount that can be divided into shares
senses.example: We shared a slice of apple pie.

reviewNotes: 馅饼及 a slice of the pie 分配份额的比喻均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: the ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid
senses.example: It took courage to admit the mistake.

reviewNotes: 勇气指害怕仍去面对，承认错误例句清楚。

author: root

senses.zh: 利益；缘故；目的；日本清酒（另读音）
senses.definition: someone's benefit or a reason for doing something; also a Japanese alcoholic drink made from rice
senses.example: For the sake of safety, keep the doorway clear.
senses.note: for the sake of 中 sake 常读 /seɪk/；日本清酒 sake 通常读 /ˈsɑː.keɪ/。

evidence.note: 核对缘故/利益与日本清酒两同形异读。

reviewNotes: for the sake of 固定短语与清酒为不同读音的同形词；加说明以防混读。

author: root

senses.definition: to win against someone, stop a plan from succeeding, reject a proposal, or prove too difficult
senses.example: The home team defeated the visitors by two goals.

senses.definition: failure to win or achieve an aim
senses.example: The team learned from its narrow defeat.

reviewNotes: 击败的动词和失败的名词均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to look steadily at someone or something for a long time
senses.example: She gazed out of the window at the hills.

senses.definition: a long steady look
senses.example: He lowered his gaze when she entered.

reviewNotes: 凝视的动词及目光的名词均有例句。

author: root

senses.definition: the state or period in which a baby develops inside a woman's body before birth
senses.example: She kept a journal during her pregnancy.

reviewNotes: 怀孕状态与妊娠期均可用；日记例句自然。

author: root

senses.definition: to make something stronger or more firmly believed, or send extra people or supplies to help
senses.example: The extra examples reinforced the main point.

reviewNotes: 加强论点与加固墙体的核心义均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 发誓；坚称；说脏话；使宣誓
senses.definition: to make a serious promise, insist that something is true, use offensive words, or make someone take an oath
senses.example: I swear I left the keys on this table.

旧版名词义不是现代通用主用法；脏话通常说 swear word。

reviewNotes: 发誓、坚称与骂人的动词义均保留；旧版不常用的名词标注移除。

author: root

senses.definition: information that helps solve a mystery or find an answer
senses.example: The note gave us a clue about where to look.

senses.definition: to give someone information that helps them understand a situation
senses.example: Can you clue me in on what happened?

reviewNotes: 线索名词和 clue someone in 的告知用法均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 薄片；一部分；斜切球；煎铲
senses.definition: a thin flat piece, a share of something, a curved sports shot, or a flat tool for lifting food
senses.example: Would you like a slice of bread?

senses.definition: to cut into thin pieces, cut through something, or hit a ball so it spins and curves
senses.example: Slice the tomatoes and put them in the bowl.

reviewNotes: 薄片、份额与煎铲义在学习者词典均可查；bread 例句优先基础义。

author: root

senses.zh: 职业；活动；占领；居住使用
senses.definition: a job or activity, control of a place by an outside force, or use of a building
senses.example: Please write your occupation on the form.

reviewNotes: 职业、活动与军事占领均可用，表格例句落实主义。

author: root

senses.definition: a lack of clear understanding, a mistake between similar things, or a disorganised situation
senses.example: The change of room caused some confusion.

reviewNotes: 困惑、混淆及现场混乱可以从房间改动例句理解。

author: root

senses.definition: a black or brown material dug from the ground and burned for heat, or pieces of it
senses.example: The old heating system burned coal.

reviewNotes: 煤和煤块均属常见物质义，供暖例句清楚。

author: root

senses.zh: 神圣的；宗教的；不可侵犯的
senses.definition: connected with religion or treated as too important to damage or question
senses.example: The mountain is sacred to local people.

reviewNotes: 宗教神圣与不可触犯的比喻义均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 公式；配方；方案；惯用表达；配方奶
senses.definition: a rule written with symbols, a recipe or plan, a fixed expression, or specially prepared milk for babies
senses.example: There is no simple formula for a happy life.

reviewNotes: 数学公式、配方、惯常方案及婴儿配方奶均常见。

author: root

senses.zh: 精确的；准确的；完全符合的
senses.definition: correct in every detail or matching something perfectly
senses.example: Can you tell me the exact time?

senses.zh: 强求；索取；使付出代价（正式）
senses.definition: to demand and obtain something, or cause someone to pay a high cost in effort or suffering
senses.example: The long journey exacted a heavy toll on the team.

reviewNotes: exact 形容词与正式动词 exact a toll/revenge 均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: done or shared by people acting as a group
senses.example: The decision was a collective effort.

senses.definition: a group whose members share work, resources, or decisions
senses.example: The artists formed a collective to share studio space.

reviewNotes: 集体形容词与合作团体名词分别有决策、艺术家例句。

author: root

senses.definition: connected with thinking, learning, remembering, and understanding
senses.example: The game is designed to develop cognitive skills.

reviewNotes: 认知形容词覆盖思考学习记忆，游戏例句一致。

author: root

senses.definition: a quality or feature that belongs to a person or thing
senses.example: Patience is an important attribute of a good teacher.

senses.definition: to regard something as caused by a person or thing, or as the work of a particular person
senses.example: She attributes her progress to regular practice.

evidence.note: 核对名词和动词重音、元音区别。

reviewNotes: attribute 名词属性和动词归因于分清，例句及搭配均正确。

author: root

senses.zh: 船长；机长；队长；上尉或海军上校
senses.definition: the person in charge of a ship, aircraft, or sports team, or an officer with a rank that depends on the armed service
senses.example: The captain announced that the flight would be delayed.
senses.note: 军衔译法随军种而变：陆军/空军通常为上尉，海军通常为上校；不统一译成某一种军衔。

senses.definition: to lead a sports team or command a ship
senses.example: She captained the school team last year.

reviewNotes: 船长机长队长和军衔均常见；动词率队保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to be brave enough to do something, or challenge someone to do a risky thing
senses.example: I did not dare to ask another question.

senses.definition: used especially in questions and negatives to express courage or lack of it
senses.example: I dare not tell him yet.

senses.definition: a challenge to do something difficult, risky, or embarrassing
senses.example: She jumped into the cold lake on a dare.

evidence.note: 官方搜索摘要确认主要动词与半情态动词分类。

reviewNotes: dare 敢于、情态辅助用法及挑战名词都有单独例句。

author: root

senses.definition: to breathe out slowly and audibly because of sadness, tiredness, or relief
senses.example: She sighed with relief when the train arrived.

senses.definition: a long outward breath showing sadness, tiredness, or relief
senses.example: He gave a sigh and closed the book.

reviewNotes: 叹气的动词与一声叹息的名词均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: the sport in which two teams try to kick a ball into the other team's goal without using their hands
senses.example: The children play soccer in the park.
senses.note: 这是通常所说的足球；英式常说 football。规则中守门员等情况有专门的用手限制与例外。

reviewNotes: soccer 指美式常用的足球，不能与橄榄球混同。

author: root

senses.zh: 画廊；展览馆；长廊；楼座；图片集
senses.definition: a place showing art, a long passage, an upper seating area, or a collection of images
senses.example: The gallery is showing paintings by local artists.

reviewNotes: 画廊、展馆、楼座和图片集均可从名词用法展开。

author: root

senses.definition: a passage through a hill, under the ground, or through another material
senses.example: The train entered a tunnel under the mountain.

senses.definition: to dig or make an underground passage
senses.example: The workers tunnelled through the hillside.

reviewNotes: 隧道名词与挖隧道动词例句对应。

author: root

senses.definition: a person or organisation accused of wrongdoing or sued in a court case
senses.example: The defendant denied the allegation.

reviewNotes: 被告可在刑事或民事案件出现，释义未错误限定刑事。

author: root

senses.zh: 体能；健康；健身；适合；适应度（生物）
senses.definition: being healthy and strong, exercising to stay so, suitability for a purpose, or success in surviving and producing young
senses.example: Swimming has helped improve her fitness.

evidence.note: 本轮查询官方词条确认身体健康强壮与合适性两个常用义。生物学补充义待独立复核。

reviewNotes: 体能健身、岗位适合及生物适应度的名词义均成立。

author: root

senses.definition: a place in the ground where a dead person's body is buried
senses.example: They placed flowers on the grave.

senses.definition: very serious or worrying, or showing a serious manner
senses.example: The news raised grave concerns about safety.

reviewNotes: 坟墓和严重的形容词义分开；去掉模糊的死亡比喻。

author: root

senses.zh: 大腿面（坐下时）；一圈；一段行程
senses.definition: the flat area above your knees when sitting, one circuit of a track, or one part of a journey
senses.example: The child fell asleep on her father's lap.
senses.note: lap 不是膝盖骨本身，而是坐下时从腰到膝上方可放东西的区域。

senses.definition: to drink with the tongue, wash gently against a shore, pass a racer by a whole circuit, or overlap at an edge
senses.example: The cat lapped water from a bowl.

reviewNotes: 大腿面、一圈与舔食动词均是常见用法。

author: root

senses.definition: one of the small parts at the end of a foot, or the part of a shoe or sock covering them
senses.example: There is a hole in the toe of my sock.

senses.zh: 用脚尖碰；服从（toe the line）
senses.definition: to touch or move with the front of the foot; in toe the line, to obey rules or expectations
senses.example: All team members are expected to toe the line.

reviewNotes: 脚趾及 toe the line 遵守规则用法均保留。

author: root

senses.zh: 容器；集装箱；容器环境（计算机）
senses.definition: an object for holding things, a large shipping box, or a separate software environment that runs an application
senses.example: Keep the food in a sealed container.

reviewNotes: 容器、集装箱和软件容器均有清楚的共性。

author: root

senses.definition: a good moral quality or a useful advantage
senses.example: Patience is a virtue when teaching young children.

reviewNotes: 美德和优点保留；by virtue of 固定搭配自然。

author: root

senses.definition: a person who designs buildings, or someone responsible for planning an important project or change
senses.example: The architect designed a house full of natural light.

senses.zh: 设计；规划（尤技术或商业）
senses.definition: to design the structure of a system or a complex plan
senses.example: The team architected a system that could grow with demand.
senses.note: 技术或商业语境常见；一般日常写作优先用 design。

reviewNotes: 建筑师主义与技术领域 architect a system 动词均保留，并标领域语境。

author: root

senses.definition: coloured substances used on the face, or the combination of parts or qualities that form someone or something
senses.example: She wears very little makeup at work.

reviewNotes: 化妆品、组成结构与性格是核心名词义；不把补考误作该名词的独立义。

author: root

senses.definition: a request for information or a careful attempt to find out facts
senses.example: The council opened an inquiry into the accident.

reviewNotes: 询问和调查两类名词义均有自然搭配。

author: root

senses.zh: 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地
senses.definition: in a way that is different from what was expected
senses.example: The room was surprisingly quiet despite the busy street.

reviewNotes: surprisingly 修饰出乎意料的程度，例句和搭配一致。

author: root

senses.definition: to draw attention to something, mark text in a bright colour, or colour some strands of hair
senses.example: The report highlights the need for better training.

senses.zh: 最精彩部分；亮点；亮部；挑染发束
senses.definition: the best or most important part, a bright part of an image, or lighter strands of hair
senses.example: Meeting the author was the highlight of my trip.

reviewNotes: 强调标亮的动词与精彩部分名词均保留。

author: root

senses.definition: to become smaller in size or amount, or make something smaller
senses.example: The noise decreased after the doors were closed.

senses.definition: a reduction in size, number, or amount
senses.example: There has been a decrease in traffic this month.

reviewNotes: 减少的动词和减少量名词均保留，数值搭配正确。
